ground_truth.description: Removing the `elif filtered.done_count > 0` branch means any FilteredTaskTree with done_count>0 but an empty done_tasks list now falls through to the `else` and renders a misleading 'No tasks.' in the Recently Completed section instead of the previous '{done_count} tasks completed recently (details omitted)' summary. The claimed non-empty invariant only holds for filter_task_tree() output and is merely warn-enforced by _check_filtered_tree_invariant, so a violating (externally-constructed / harness / deserialized) tree silently feeds the reconciliation LLM 'No tasks.' despite tasks having completed — a plausible source of the escalation_created signal.

The rewritten test (formerly test_recently_completed_shows_count_when_no_done_tasks_objects) and the other edited fixtures all switch done_count to 0, deleting every remaining test that exercises the done_count>0 with empty done_tasks path. Combined with removing the elif branch, there is now zero coverage of that scenario, so the misleading 'No tasks.' fallback regression is untested.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
